scope: Native browser review of the public Crossref completed run network evidence view, not full-site certification.

native_checks.check: Network evidence dialog opens from the run header
Actual HTTP 200 records, provider origin, snapshot SHA, explicit Asia/Shanghai time and source-vs-conclusion distinction visible
Escape closes the dialog and focus returns to its network trigger
Snapshot action opens web_sources.json for the exact current run; displayed SHA matches the frozen index
Nested artifact preview closes, then source dialog closes and returns focus
Temporary viewport override reset at end

controlled_node_scope: Three actual request mode handlers auto/on/off
Unsafe URL and untrusted text rejection
Stale, closed, failed and identity-mismatched dialog requests
unverified: S1 production deployment and live authorization/attachment flow
note: Earlier frontend audit records remain historical. No private task history or private person output is included.
